name: robosuite
summary: robosuite provides standardized robot models, controllers, task definitions and teleoperation interfaces over MuJoCo, designed so environments, robots and controllers can be recombined freely. Its real influence is as infrastructure: robomimic, RoboCasa and many other benchmarks are built on it.
innovation: Clean separation of robot, controller, task and observation modality, enabling genuinely controlled comparisons.
Standard controller implementations — operational space, joint impedance — that removed a common hidden confound.
matters: The quiet foundation under a large share of academic manipulation research.
limits: Inherits MuJoCo's contact approximations, and is not designed for photorealism.
lineage: A modular research framework layered on MuJoCo, feeding the benchmark lineage.
